Recognizing that these impulses are deeply rooted in biology doesn't necessarily mean they aren't valid motivations for living. While current consciousness offers limited insight into our past, exploring personal values and purposeful choices can still help you feel more intentional in your own life.

it feels like the only way to actually break the loop, and prove i'm not just a biological machine, is to make a choice that goes completely against every single instinct i have. if i can't choose to end it, then i don't actually have agency at all. i'm just a program running its course. doesnt it seem like the only truly free act would be to reject the programming entirely?
